record.question: What is the name of the Air Defence System to be procured from Russia?
record.explanation: Answer A: S-400 Missile. India signed the contract for five S-400 long-range surface-to-air missile systems from Russia on 5 October 2018. The Defence Ministry’s 2 January 2019 parliamentary reply supplies that contract identity, which matches S-400. Historical/source note: A procurement question at the April 2019 date; the source’s prospective delivery schedule is not asserted as a later accomplished fact. Reference: https://www.pib.gov.in/PressReleasePage.aspx?PRID=1558148&lang=2&reg=48. Verified worked solution, unofficial. Historical facts are anchored to the original exam; no matching examiner key is asserted.
